newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end flat, seen sideways.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end flat, seen sideways.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austrian bonds ended the week flat after a subdued session and traders were pinning their hopes on a batch of U.S. economic data due next week to infuse some life into the market.
"That should give the market a positive push upwards," said one trader. "Today was totally quiet and restrained."
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 up five bps at 99.50 to yield 5.69 (5.70) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.36/46 to yield 5.71/70 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up 10 bps at 99.95 to yield 4.63 (4.66) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.90/100.00 to yield 4.65/62 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 12 bps at 109.24 on turnover of 117 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at four bps, five-year spread at 17 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.397 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38.
